reviews.title: Forward or reverse fans Quiet Easy to use.
reviews.comment: Great fans, quiet.  I needed a combination of forward and reverse fans to cool my case.  These provided the options I needed.  Easy to install, the ganging feature is great and simple to use.  It also allows you to change the direction of the cable very easily.  The RGB controller was easy to use and configure.  It just needs the USB cable plugged into the motherboard.
reviews.author: PhotoBuff58

reviews.author: raudy caceres

reviews.title: Excellent performance.
reviews.comment: The seller diverted on time. The product is easy to install. These fans run quietly, the lighting is beautiful and the L Connect software is great. I like how you have many options to control lighting, speed, and the presets are awesome if you don't want to customize. There is also the option to give control of lighting or fan speed to your motherboard. These are expensive but it's not your ordinary fan. I have installed 10 of these in my case and I could barely hear them on quiet setting. If you have extra in your butget I don't believe these will disappoint the end result.
reviews.author: Mauricio V.

reviews.title: Easy Connect Looks Great
reviews.comment: Purchased as a rear exhaust fan to match the rest of the SL-INF fans I have in my case. Fan works great and looks good doing it. Being able to swap which way the power cable comes out came in handy to keep the installation clean and wires hidden.
